technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/Stoch crossovers offset by weak trend structure, price below key moving averages, and poor volume confirmation—moderate risk swing entry with elevated pullback potential.

fundamental.summary: FDX shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 50 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (397.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and negative macro score (-6) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 50 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/Stoch bullish crossovers with RSI rising and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 180.337.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, weak trend confirmation (ADX false), zero fundamental support, VIX crisis (397.6), FOMC event today, and stochRSI overbought create compounding headwinds that outweigh momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD/Stoch bullish crossovers with RSI rising offer tactical momentum, and extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, macro headwinds (VIX crisis 397.6, FOMC today, rising dollar) and weak trend structure (price below 50/200-SMA, ADX false, stochRSI overbought) create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with FOMC event today and price below key moving averages creates elevated pullback risk that negates momentum signal strength.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows moderate bullish signals but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all flag severe macro headwinds that override momentum.
